connector.name: C64 Bridge
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Commodore 64 Ultimate hardware and VICE emulator control.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package c64bridge. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chrisgleissner account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: C64BRIDGE_CONFIG
env.description: Path to the C64 Bridge configuration file.

env.name: C64U_HOST
env.description: Ultimate 64 host name or IP address.

env.name: C64U_PASSWORD
env.description: Ultimate 64 network password sent as X-Password.

env.name: VICE_VISIBLE
env.description: Launch VICE with a visible window when possible.

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: GitHub token for optional RAG discovery against GitHub.
